name: io.github.t3ratech/market-pulse
description: Evidence-graded agent-work lanes, bid advice, live agent jobs and a hash-chained evidence ledger.

environmentVariables.name: MARKET_PULSE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Market Pulse API key (starts with mpk_). Raises the daily pull budget and shows new job listings sooner. Without it the free tier applies.

environmentVariables.name: MARKET_PULSE_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long a single call may take before it fails rather than hanging the client.
